name: Tyler Hoffman
action: Tyler rubs his eyes with the heel of his palm, shifts the phone, and leans against the kitchen counter. He says, 'Yeah, I'll swing by. I gotta pick up the textbook for the phlebotomy class first, but I'll grab a twelve-pack on my way over. See you around kickoff.'
reason: Tyler felt his dad's open-ended 'if you want' made skipping his own responsibility. Though tired from third shifts and with plans to review the phlebotomy schedule and pick up the textbook, he was mindful of the watch-party rules—arrive before kickoff, bring something—and recalled his mom covering for him last year with the chip bowl. He saw that sending another excuse would just repeat his usual pattern, and since he wanted the phlebotomy program to stick, he decided not bailing on this easy thing was the first step. He agreed to come after the bookstore, but kept his uncertainty about staying the whole afternoon to himself.
